verdict.rationale: Reflect documents one-click, in-app publishing that makes a note publicly available behind a long, hard-to-guess URL with clean, minimal styling. The evidence covers only individual notes shared by unlisted URLs, not a browsable website or digital garden. Missing for 10: publishing a collection as a navigable site, links between published notes that resolve to each other, site navigation or index, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
